_meta.openai/widgetDescription: Journey card showing ferry departures/arrivals with piers and line numbers, the island walk (km, time), time on the island and booking requirements. Do not repeat these in text; add only advice.

description: Plan a multi-day trip on the Stockholm Archipelago Trail: an overnight stay on one island, or an island hop across up to four stages, with the ferries and the walk for each day. Use this when the user wants a hike over several days, an overnight stay on an island, or to combine two or more islands. Sections take the same identifiers as fetch (sat:section:…, slug or uid), in the order they should be visited. sections and date are both OPTIONAL: omit sections and the planner picks well-served stages; omit date and it uses the next Saturday — so call this tool for ANY multi-day request ("plan a 3-day hike"), never answer from search/fetch alone. Do not use for single-day trips (use day_trip) or A→B between two islands on one day (use plan_route). ALWAYS follow this call with show_section_map for the first stage of the trip (same date) so the user sees the route on a map. IMPORTANT: every call to this tool renders a card in the conversation. Call it at most ONCE per answer, for the single option you recommend. Never use it to compare or probe alternatives. The card already shows ferry times, piers and walking times — do not restate them in your reply; add only advice, caveats and next steps.

date.description: Start date, YYYYMMDD (Europe/Stockholm), e.g. 20260905. OPTIONAL — omit and the planner uses the next Saturday.

hub.description: Optional preferred departure hub slug from check_day_trip/day_trip responses, e.g. 'stromkajen'. Omit to let the planner pick the best.

lang.description: Language of the user's message: 'sv' when the user writes in Swedish, otherwise 'en'. Always pass it — labels, dates and the card are rendered in this language.

sections.description: One to four section references in visiting order: satId, slug or uid — e.g. ['grinda', 'finnhamn'].

name: multi_day

outputSchema.description: A multi-day trip: kind "multi-day" carries one entry per day with its ferries and island walk; kind "no-multi-day" explains in `reason` why none could be built.

days.description: One entry per calendar day, earliest first — including rest days (`rest: true`), so day N is the Nth day of the trip.

ferries.description: Ferry hops that day, in order. Each hop is listed separately, so transfers are visible.

booking.description: Set when the hop must be pre-booked by phone.

rest.description: True for a rest day: a calendar day with no ferries and no walking — you stay put on the island.

walk.description: Walking that day, on the stage it mostly belongs to.

hub.description: Mainland ferry hub the trip departs from. Absent for road-accessible stages (no ferry).

permalink.description: Opens exactly this trip in the planner.

reason.description: Only on kind "no-multi-day": why no trip could be built.

sections.description: Section slugs, in the order they are visited.

suggestedFollowUps.description: Short next steps. Offer these to the user as quick follow-up options at the end of your reply.

titles.description: Display names of the sections, same order.

totalWalkKm.description: Total walking distance for the whole trip, km.
